Later final R6 decisions refined the same artifact: FHIR-47245 removed the uri-valued NutritionOrder instantiates elements and initially renamed instantiatesCanonical, FHIR-43447 removed the remaining instantiates-style element and fixed performer/product mappings, FHIR-53504 documents current ballot guidance to use workflow instantiates extensions, and FHIR-36664/FHIR-37965 filled related NutritionOrder Request-pattern mapping gaps already represented on the combined branch.
